concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-paypal-messaging-javascript-v3]] - collected JavaScript v3 documentation route whose retained body instead records native iOS/Android Pay Later Messaging eligibility, Drop-in exclusion, one-time-payment and PayPal-checkout conditions, no-edit rules and category restrictions
warnings: Do not treat this route as JavaScript v3 setup evidence; the collected body describes native iOS/Android scope.
Keep promotional messaging separate from generic offer identity, merchant enablement, buyer approval and payment completion.
Treat current-tense availability as snapshot evidence, not proof of current merchant or buyer eligibility.

concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-paypal-messaging-javascript-v3]] - Braintree Pay Later Messaging route preserving the captured native iOS/Android eligibility, Drop-in exclusion and promotional-content restrictions while flagging the absence of JavaScript v3 setup content
warnings: Do not generalize the page's native-SDK language to Braintree Web or another SDK.
Do not infer current enablement, offer terms, buyer approval or payment execution from this messaging page.
